pr.title: Fix #1911: sync pipeline state after implement-phase push + PR creation
pr.description:
Fixes the three distinct bugs from #1911 that together caused false-positive `post-consensus-push-stall` alerts on successful /sdlc runs:

1. `_finalize_pr_phase_failed` now writes `pipeline.pr_number` and (when `gh pr view` succeeds) `pipeline.pr_head_sha` after successful auto-PR creation, not just the `pr_url` phase artifact. Issue-mode consumers (overseer, `get_pipeline_snapshot`, babysit-worker handoffs) can now rely on `pipeline.pr_number` directly.

2. The overseer `post-consensus-push-stall` detector now short-circuits when any transition-completion evidence is visible: `pipeline.current_phase != "implement"`, `pipeline.pr_number is not None`, or a `pr_url` phase artifact exists. Genuine stalls (none of those populated) still fire.

3. `_update_agents_complete` now logs a WARN when the BRC tracker returns null/sentinel commit SHAs for a role, so we can diagnose the three-role implement-phase (coder/tester/documenter) wiring gap instead of silently dropping the null.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: extended `orchestrator/tests/test_finalize_pr_phase.py` covers the `pr_number`/`pr_head_sha` writeback on the happy path and the gh-unavailable fallback. New tests in `orchestrator/tests/test_overseer_monitor.py` cover each overseer short-circuit branch. Full orchestrator pytest suite remains green.
- Manual: run `/sdlc` end-to-end on a small fix and confirm via `get_pipeline_snapshot` after post-consensus that `pipeline.pr_number` and `pipeline.pr_head_sha` are populated and the overseer does not fire a stall alert.
pr.manual_steps:
Pre-merge: run `make lint test` from the repo root and confirm green.
Post-merge: monitor the next few /sdlc runs for any `BRC tracker returned no commit sha for completed agent` warnings — those are the diagnostic added by task-1-3 and flag the follow-up three-role wiring investigation.
